benchmark.definition: own_H[:, :, n20].mean(): the paper's 20-step adversary run on each unseen (held-out) batch itself, mean over the 16 held-out batches and 5 starts, raw nats per token

random_start.definition: init_H.mean(): the random starting point's harm on the unseen batches, mean over the 16 held-out batches and 5 starts, raw nats per token

paper_table.source: the paper's PGD table, tab:vpd-pgd-ce (literature/original/bushnaq2026_vpd.txt, lines 395-399)

note: The points are 80 searches (16 attack batches by 5 starts) read at up to eight moments each (five search lengths and three harm levels), not 637 independent masks. A harm-level point can be the same setting as a step point when the level's crossing fell on a saved step.
